records.title: Adapting While Learning: Grounding LLMs for Scientific Problems with Tool Usage Adaptation
records.reason: The primary paper proposes training-time adaptation that teaches an LLM to answer easy scientific questions directly and invoke tools for harder ones, reducing unnecessary tool use while improving accuracy across six scientific benchmarks. It does not report inference latency, token, or compute savings, so its link to efficient reasoning is plausible but not established.

records.title: MetaAlign: Align Large Language Models with Diverse Preferences during Inference Time
records.reason: MetaAlign performs inference-time preference alignment using additional optimization/generation to improve preference satisfaction. Its experiments focus on helpfulness and diverse opinions, not reducing compute, memory, latency, or serving cost.

records.title: Promises and Pitfalls of Generative Masked Language Modeling: Theoretical Framework and Practical Guidelines
records.reason: This paper gives a theoretical and practical review of generative masked language models, their capabilities and limitations. Non-autoregressive generation is relevant to the linked sequence-modeling family, but the paper is not itself an efficiency method or a demonstrated inference accelerator.

records.title: GEC-DePenD: Non-Autoregressive Grammatical Error Correction with Decoupled Permutation and Decoding
records.reason: GEC-DePenD proposes non-autoregressive grammatical-error correction with decoupled permutation and decoding, addressing sequential decoding for one correction task. Full-text evidence is task-specific and does not establish general LLM inference gains; keep as a weak NAR lineage connection.

records.title: Data-driven material screening of secondary and natural cementitious precursors
records.reason: The paper applies LLM-based extraction to screen cementitious material compositions and studies materials properties/decarbonization. LLMs are an enabling analysis tool; no inference efficiency contribution is made.
